description: Translate the emergency call and the opening of the Chibickmon search mission.

english:
Ngh...! Hey,
hey, hey...
Wh-what is it?
What's going
on?!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
...What
happened all of
a sudden,
Shoutmon?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
The Pickmon on
the Sky
Fortress... Ow!
My ears!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.
Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
They're yelling
something over
the emergency
channel, but
they're
panicking and
shouting so
much... I can't
understand a
word!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.
Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
Maybe ROG
attacked again!
Let's hurry
back to the Sky
Fortress!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
Ah, Taiki! Did
you hear the
call?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
This is
serious,
brother!
Chibickmon...!
That little
Pickmon from
the Pickmons
was kidnapped!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
Kidnapped...?
By whom? When?
Why? Where did
they take it?!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
We don't
know...! We
don't know what
happened... We
looked away for
just a moment,
and it was
gone. S-sorry,
brother! We
were supposed
to keep an eye
on it...
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
Could it have
just gotten
lost...? Maybe
it's playing
somewhere?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
No... If even
the other
Pickmon called
out and it
didn't answer,
it's probably
not just lost.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.

english:
Actually, the
last Digimon to
see the little
one heard it
say, 'Wait up,
big sis!' I
think it
followed
someone.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated directly from Japanese; Chibickmon and other Digimon names use the project naming style.
